direction.premise: Compact offline file workshop: bytes are physically compressed between two plates; privacy and measurable savings dominate the utility.
direction.composition: A dark, narrow operation rail sits to the left of a light editorial workspace. Files stack as narrow ledger rows; a right-hand measuring press compares original/result byte lengths.
direction.shapeLanguage: Squarish mechanical stamps, narrow technical rules, angular plates and precise flat edges; no rounded cards.
direction.surfaceAndMaterial: Warm light limestone workstation with an opaque graphite press rail and flat oxidized orange mechanical lever. No paper texture, glass or dark neon.
direction.paletteLogic: Ivory #f3f0e8 preserves image neutrality; graphite #242924 is operation equipment; restrained rust-orange #ce632d denotes active force and live progress; green signals verified savings.
direction.typography: Bold practical Trebuchet title, reliable neutral body type, compact monospace metadata and file sizes.
direction.signature: A physical two-plate glyph and measured before/after parallel tracks: size reduction is the central interaction and measurable consequence.
direction.distinction: Unlike Folkarium's page and music notation, Sin Guion's blue panels, Rivals DNA's paper dossier, Bunny Bloom's illustrated garden, and Trace Mosaic's copper restoration board, this is a spare utilitarian file press with a permanent operation rail and physical compression measure.

architecture.primaryVerb: Choose photos, videos, files or a ZIP; process on-device; save actual output.
architecture.physicalFeedback: File rows appear on selection, real processing percentage and size reports update, verified outputs enable download; errors remain on failed rows.
architecture.spatialRationale: Desktop keeps four operations in a fixed vertical rail and settings beside the queue; phone folds the rail to four single-tap operation tabs and stacks settings below files.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Permanent dark tool rail and mineral surface instead of a wide vellum score.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Batch processing, encoding, saving files rather than editing musical notes.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Light open queue with a narrow graphite rail, not blue station screens.
comparisons.interactionDifference: File selection, progress and byte totals rather than language drills.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Operational file rows and a results ruler rather than full-page dossiers.
comparisons.interactionDifference: No questions or ranking; direct filesystem workflow.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Dense editorial workstation rather than an illustrated garden world.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Compression actions with measurable file outputs rather than growing a flower.

production.renderer: Static semantic DOM and CSS, local author-generated SVG press icon, JS Canvas for encoding, browser-native ZIP streams.
production.focalAsset: Two compression plates squeeze a small orange data bar in a square vector icon.

motion.character: Compressed press feedback: rows insert from a short 5px offset and byte meter settles when real work finishes.
motion.action: Choose files, select quality, process, and download.
motion.anticipation: Drop border responds immediately to files dragged over.
motion.response: Live progress and updated results; controls lock only while processing.
motion.followThrough: Measured savings replaces the neutral settings area and output controls become available.
motion.interruption: Cancel uses AbortController and retains results already completed; no unstable auto-resume of video after backgrounding.
motion.reducedMotion: Animation and transition durations forced to zero.

evidence.expectedChange: Workspace visibly switches to ZIP creation, exposes folder selector and archive filename.
